editor.name: Project name
editor.tooManyDownloads: Too many downloads in a minute. Try again in {s} s.
editor.conflictText: Since you opened it here, the project has been saved from another window or device. The changes on this screen are not saved, but they are not lost: save them as a separate project. “Reload” shows the other version, and the changes here are dropped. Files are made from the saved project — for this version, download them from the copy.
editor.copyFailed: The copy was not created (you may have reached the maximum number of projects). The changes are still on screen — try again.
editor.sessionText: The changes are on this screen and are not lost — do not close the tab. Sign in again in a new tab and come back here: the save starts by itself, and “Save again” runs it at once.
editor.signIn: Sign in in a new tab
editor.catalogFailed: The catalogue did not load, so the project is open for viewing only — otherwise its hardware and decors would quietly change to the basic ones. Reload the page.
editor.engineFailed: This value cannot be computed and the previous one is back. Try another; if the error stays, write to us.
editor.openFailed: The project cannot be computed, so it is open for viewing only. Reload the page; if the error stays, write to us.
editor.showFailed: The project cannot be shown. Reload the page; if the error stays, write to us.
editor.driftTitle: Part of this project is no longer in the catalogue
editor.driftText: The editor shows the substitute listed below. Choose again, or save the project as it is — until then the CNC files cannot be downloaded and the drawings are marked as not for production.
editor.noWebgl: This browser does not support WebGL 2, so the 3D view cannot be shown. The other tabs work.
editor.noWebglHint: Turn on hardware acceleration in the browser settings, or open the project on another device.

export.note: Files are generated from the last saved version.

editor.readOnlyText: The project opens and downloads, but changes are not saved. Choose a plan to make changes.
editor.onion: Onion skin 0.3 mm — small parts do not move
editor.compensation: Cut sizes compensate for the edge banding
editor.shelfLoad: Shelf load (check: deflection up to 0.5% of the span between supports)
editor.zoomArea: Drawing: the arrow keys move the sheet, + and − zoom, 0 shows the whole sheet
editor.zoomHint: Wheel or two fingers — zoom · drag — move · double click — whole sheet
editor.zoomTap: Click or tap the drawing — full screen, zoomed in on that spot
editor.photoUnsupported: This browser cannot show the photorealistic view.
editor.photoFailed: The photorealistic view did not start. The normal view still works.
editor.photoSaveFailed: The picture was not saved. Please try again.
editor.viewHint: Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, right button to move. Decor colours are approximate and the texture is procedural.
editor.drillTitle: Where each hinge, handle and slide goes
editor.drillNote: The hinge schemes come from the official documents of Blum, Hettich, GTV and Salice. The cup distance C is calculated from the manufacturer's overlay formula, so the door overlaps exactly as in the model. Slide holes follow the GTV and Blum templates. Values marked “our choice” are decisions of the program where the document says nothing.
editor.nestNote: MaxRects nesting with best fit; parts with grain are not rotated. Each decor goes on separate sheets — for a small order, use cutting to size or offcuts.
editor.drawNote: First-angle projection (European), sizes in mm. The drawing number comes from the hash of the specification.
editor.safetyText: Zero point: X0 Y0 at the lower left corner of the sheet, Z0 on its top surface. Tool numbers are a sample machine profile. Simulate in the machine's software and do a dry run.
editor.cncBlockedText: The construction checks found errors, and G-code and DXF must never be wrong. Fix them — this tab unlocks by itself:
editor.cncBlockedLink: the construction has errors — see the CNC tab
editor.catSearch: Search by name, brand, code, shop…
editor.catNote: Prices and availability come from the shops' public pages on the catalogue date and may have changed — check them when you order. “Drillable” means there is a documented hole scheme.

build.templateText: “{type}” is a template: its columns follow one rule. Customise it and every column and every compartment becomes yours — widths, heights, shelves, drawers, rails and doors one by one. The sizes, materials and hardware stay.
build.otherText: “{type}” cannot be customised yet. Start a free-form cabinet with the same materials and hardware and lay it out column by column.
build.drawersOwn: Drawers have their own fronts — no door goes over them.
build.frontOther: A door covers compartments {from}–{to} here. Select them together to change it, or put a new front here only.
build.hint: Click selects a compartment, Shift+click several one above the other for one door; the arrow keys move the selection. The boundaries between columns and the fixed shelves drag with a mouse or a finger, and with the arrow keys when focused (Shift: 10 mm). Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo.

handle.noneFronts: the fronts open with TIP-ON or a profile — not included

ui.noSlides: No drawer slides with drilling data
ui.noBedFittings: No bed connectors in the catalogue

drill.noHardware: This model has no hinges, handles or drawer slides.

cup.left: cup Ø{d} × {depth}, {boring} mm from the hinge edge (centre at {centre}); left edge
cup.right: cup Ø{d} × {depth}, {boring} mm from the hinge edge (centre at {centre}); right edge

drill.byTemplate: with the manufacturer's template — no holes in the G-code
drill.heightsFull: heights from edge “{edge}” — the full list is on the map and in the CSV
drill.axes: X (u) from edge “{u0}” towards “{u1}” · Y (v) from edge “{v0}” towards “{v1}” · face A up

manual.one: {n} hole has no drill in the library: {list} — drill it by hand.
manual.other: {n} holes have no drill in the library: {list} — drill them by hand.

post.iso: ISO / Fanuc style (G81, G43, tool change T…M6)

bom.grain: The grain runs along the length
bom.bandHint: Edge banding is given in exact lengths, with no trimming allowance.

unpriced.one: {n} item without a price — a fastener or general fitting.
unpriced.other: {n} items without a price — fasteners and general fittings.

bom.edgeHint: Horizontal holes in the edges are not made on a 3-axis machine: use a boring machine or a jig.

viewer.label: 3D view of the furniture: drag or arrow keys — rotate, wheel or + and − — zoom, 0 — the whole piece

exports.cutList: the parts to cut (cut sizes, edge banding, decor)
exports.drilling: every hole: part, face, coordinates, diameter, depth
exports.drawings: assembly drawing and a drawing of every part with its drilling map (SVG, A3); the number in the name is the sheet number ({assembly} is the assembly drawing)
exports.cnc: DXF with layers and G-code for every nesting sheet
exports.cncBlocked: NOT ISSUED: the checks found errors, and G-code and DXF must never be wrong. Fix them in the editor and download again:
exports.machine: The G-code is for a sample machine profile (tool numbers, zero point at the bottom left corner of the sheet, Z0 on the top surface). Before cutting: simulate it in the machine software and do a dry run.
